If the UK bond yields 10% and the US bond yields 5%, the higher nominal return does not guarantee a better investment. A 5% higher bond return can be erased by a 5% depreciation of the foreign currency. If the pound is expected to depreciate relative to the dollar, investing in the UK bond may lose value when converted back. If the dollar is expected to appreciate 5% relative to the pound, the investor is indifferent between the two bonds. Net return from both US and UK bonds is 5% when exchange-rate effects are accounted for. Equilibrium requires the two investment returns to be equal.
